$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFQK (AIP France, chart dated 2022-05-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Châlons - Écury-sur-Coole

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.

Except for safety related communications, aircrafts entering the aerodrome circuit are required to listen for at least two minutes of the frequency to ensure that there is no winching operation in progress, the use of the frequency may hinder communication between the operator and the glider pilot.
During winching periods, do not perform site reconnaissance at <2500ft AMSL.
Preferred QFU: 035° due to noise nuisance.
TKOF and LDG must be stopped when a glider is unmoved on the glider runway at less than a half width of the common limit.
For aircraft, after TKOF QFU 215°, take the heading 200°.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Gliders winch activity on RWY 04R / 22L (NR 954): SFC1700 ft ASFC / 2100 AMSL, SR-SS.
User information on FREQ A / A Ecury.
Glider aerobatic activity (NR 6102) over RWY 04/22 axis, into the RWY limits,1500 ft AMSL / 5000 ft AMSL, SAT, SUN and HOL: SR-SS.
Reserved for gliders authorized by the DSAC Nord-est.
Activity known of SEINE INFO or PARIS INFO in case of SEINE INFO closing.
AEM (NR 8241): upper limit at 800 ft ASFC (1150 ft AMSL) if no glider activity (NR 6102) in aerodrome traffic.
In case of glider activity, upper limit at 350 ft ASFC (700 ft AMSL).
